newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Aboitiz Equity to invest in power projects.
newsitem.headline: Aboitiz Equity to invest in power projects.

text.p: Holding concern Aboitiz Equity Ventures Inc said on Tuesday its board had approved investments of 672 million pesos in three power projects.
These include equity investments in Western Mindanao Power Corp and Southern Mindanao Power Corp, two power projects in joint venture with Alsons Power Holdings Corp and Tomen Corp of Japan.

AEVI said it will have a 20 percent equity investment of 189 million pesos in Western Mindanao Power Corp which will build a 100 mega watt (mw) bunker-fired electricity generating plant in Zamboanga city, southern Philippines for National Power Corp (NPC) at an estimated project cost of $120.0 million.
Another is a 20 percent equity investment of 108 million pesos in Southern Mindanao which will build a 50 mw bunker-fired power plant under a build-operate-and-transfer scheme with NPC.

The third investment is the 33.34 share out ot the total equity of about 1.26 billion pesos in Luzon Hydro Corp, a joint venture with Pacific Hydro Group of Australia and Ever Electrical Manufacturing Corp.
Luzon Hydro will undertake a 70 mw hydro-electrical plant in Benguet, northern Philippines.
AEVI also disclosed it planned to join the bid for the 1,200- mw gas-fired plant in Batangas, south of Manila together with AES Corp and Nichimen Corp of Japan.
